description: This file contains unit tests for the activation rebalancer component in an Orleans-based system. It tests the control operations such as suspend, resume, and reporting subscriptions, verifying the expected behavior and state transitions of the rebalancer.

classes.name: ControlRebalancerTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying rebalancer control functionalities including suspend, resume, and reporting, in an Orleans activation rebalancer context.

classes.name: Listener
classes.description: A private nested class within the test to implement report listening behavior for rebalancer report events.

methods.name: Rebalancer_Should_Be_Controllable_And_Report_To_Listeners
methods.description: Test method that verifies the ability to control the rebalancer (suspend/resume), subscribe to reports, and check correct status updates and report contents over different suspended and resumed states.

methods.name: OnReport
methods.description: Event handler called when a report is received, updating the stored report.
